title: fix(ui): a lookup's group headers and filter options read the target's nameField, and the empty group is translated
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AJJJRiYjshMUNgyMZSqBsr)_

Fixes #35053

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表按查找字段分组时的分组标题(服务端分组与客户端分组)、筛选器里查找字段的候选值,在查找字段未声明 `displayField` 时改用目标对象声明的 `nameField` 命名,不再显示原始记录 id;空值分组的标题改用网格已有的「空」文案(`grid.empty`),随语言翻译。
- **为什么改**:spec 对 `displayField` 的默认值写明是「被引用对象的 name/title」,单元格与记录页头早已这样做;这三处却只猜 `name/label/title`,目标对象以自动编号等字段为标题时(如 `DEAL-2026-0001`),中文用户看到的是一串 id 和英文的 `(empty)`。
- **风险与回滚**:只改显示文案,分组与筛选仍按 id;新增读取目标对象定义(每个目标对象一次,适配器有元数据缓存)。英文空分组从 `(empty)` 变为 `Empty`,位置不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useServerGrouping.ts`(标题读取处并行读目标定义)、`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`(`LookupValuePicker` 改为存记录、渲染时算标签)、`ui/packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts`(新增 `referencedRecordTitle`,从 `getRecordDisplayName` 拆出无兜底的一段)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/lookupGroupNameField-35053.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-lookup-namefield-35053.test.tsx`,预期 10 个用例全绿(含 zh-CN 空分组显示「空」)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One resolver.** `@object-ui/core` adds `referencedRecordTitle(targetDef, record, displayField?)`: the lookup's own `displayField`, then the target object's `getRecordDisplayName` ladder (declared `nameField` first, ADR-0079), stopping short of the `Record #ID` / `Untitled` floor and answering `undefined` there, so each caller keeps its own face for an unnamed record. `getRecordDisplayName` is split into the rungs above the floor (`recordTitleAboveFloor`, module-private) plus the floor, so the two cannot drift; its behaviour is unchanged.
- **Server-grouped headers** (`useServerGroupHeaders`): the label read now reads the target's definition in parallel with the record read (`readLookupTargetDef`) and names each id through `referencedRecordTitle`. Before: `displayField`, else `name ?? label ?? title`, else the raw id.
- **Client grouping** (`useObjectGridGrouping`'s `groupValueFormatter`): a lookup grouping field's expanded record is named through `referencedRecordTitle` with the target definition (`useLookupTargetDefs`, enabled only on the client path) and the field's `displayField`. Before: the `displayField` was ignored and the `name ?? label ?? title ...` guess ran. `buildSegmentLabel`'s object arm, used by the published `useGroupedData` with no formatter, now runs the same resolver with no target definition (record-only ladder) instead of its own key list.
- **Filter value picker** (`LookupValuePicker`): `displayField` no longer defaults to `"name"`; the target definition is read through `@object-ui/react`'s `useSettledSchema` (one read per picker mount), and options plus the chosen value's chip are labelled at render through `referencedRecordTitle`, so a definition that lands after the search still names them. Options and selections stay keyed and written by id.
- **Empty group heading**: the literal `(empty)` is replaced by the grid's existing empty-value key `grid.empty` (translated in all twelve packs: `Empty`, `空`, ...), read inside `useGroupedDataInOptionOrder` through `useGridTranslation`. No new locale key. The empty group keeps its place in label order by its KEY, not its heading (`compareGroupLabels`): first ascending, last descending, as the untranslated heading always sorted.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/lookupGroupNameField-35053.test.tsx`: per producer (server-grouped, client-grouped) a target with `nameField: 'deal_number'` and no name/label/title heads its groups with the deal numbers; CONTROL that an explicit `displayField` still wins; two records sharing one title stay two groups; zh-CN empty group reads `空` and keeps its place.
- New `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-lookup-namefield-35053.test.tsx`: options read the deal numbers and the picked value written is the id; the chosen value's chip reads the deal number; CONTROL that an explicit `displayField` wins.
- `record-title.test.ts`: four pins on `referencedRecordTitle` (nameField, displayField wins, undefined where `getRecordDisplayName` floors, record-only ladder without a definition).
- Updated pinned headings `'(empty)'` to `'Empty'` in `groupSelectOptionOrder-11809`, `groupDateHeading-13234` and `serverGroupingFieldSwitch-11574` (the ascending order controls there stay green, which is the order-preservation evidence).

## Acceptance notes

- PM mechanism assumption measured: none of the three producers had the target object's definition in hand. The grid loads only the grouped object's definition (`objectFields`, which carries `reference` and `displayField`, not the target's `nameField`); the lookup cell's target-schema cache is private to `@object-ui/fields`, which `@object-ui/components` cannot import (cycle). Cheapest correct path taken: `dataSource.getObjectSchema(target)`, one per target per header load / per change of the client grouping's target list / per picker mount. The ObjectStack adapter serves repeat reads from its metadata cache, and the lookup cells on the same screen already read the same targets, so in the Console this is normally zero extra network requests.
- The published `useGroupedData` with no formatter now names an expanded record by `referencedRecordTitle`'s record-only ladder: `name`, `full_name`, `fullName`, `display_name`, `displayName`, `title`, `subject`, `label`, then the `*_name` / `*_title` affix scan. The old list put `label` before `title` and had no `subject` or affix leg.
- English readers now see `Empty` where they saw `(empty)`; that is the grid's existing empty-value string, chosen over minting a new key per the dispatch.
- Observation, not filed: `@object-ui/fields`' private `resolveLookupRecordName` performs the same operation by calling `getRecordDisplayName` and string-matching the floor; it could call `referencedRecordTitle` instead. Outside this claim's file surface.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation, one leg per producer plus the empty label (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven blob == HEAD each time; vitest resolves the ui packages from src)</summary>

- server: `referencedRecordTitle(targetDef, rec, ...)` replaced by the old `displayField ?? name ?? label ?? title` read: 2 failed (the nameField pin and the zh-CN pin, which also reads the deal numbers); the `displayField` CONTROL stayed green.
- client: `lookupTargetDefs?.get(meta.target)` replaced by `undefined`: 3 failed (nameField, same-title, zh-CN); CONTROL green.
- picker: `targetDef` replaced by `undefined`: 2 failed (options, chip); CONTROL green.
- empty label: `t('grid.empty')` replaced by `'(empty)'`: 6 failed (every heading list that includes the empty group); the picker file green.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs at head 2e944beb</summary>

- Targeted: 8 files, 162 tests passed.
- `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/components` whole packages (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/ packages/plugin-grid/ packages/components/`): Test Files 1017 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 11601 passed, 51 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `type-check` for the same three packages: exit 0.

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 38 families; all 38 run with exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 38 accounted, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero).
- `ui` `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `overlap-check`: clean against origin/main b1eb500d, 0 PR heads.
